full_list.title_en: Solvable coupled cluster states in d=infty with prescribed momentum distribution
full_list.title_zh: d=infty 中具有规定动量分布的可解耦合簇态
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.41976v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two of the most successful ideas in many-body theory, the exponential coupled cluster ansatz and DMFT, have to date developed separately. We establish a connection between them, by showing that the infinite dimensional limit of the hypercubic lattice allows the exact closed-form evaluation of static expectation values of coupled cluster wave functions, provided the cluster amplitudes admit a low-rank decomposition. As a result, evaluation errors -- a serious concern in conventional coupled cluster theory -- can be disentangled from limitations to expressivity of coupled cluster states. For this family of coupled cluster states, the cavity construction in d→infty exactly reduces the environment of a lattice site to a Gaussian Grassmann kernel, and irreducible diagrams for one-body expectation values are found to be site-diagonal (in analogy to the DMFT self-energy). The resulting ``impurity problem" is an integral over a finite number of Grassmann variables rather than a dynamical quantum impurity problem, so that static observables derive exactly from a static self-consistency condition: a wave function counterpart of DMFT. For the simplest case of a cluster amplitude restricted to rank-one doubles, we obtain the momentum distribution in closed form. We show that any momentum distribution can be realized by a state that is the exact and unique ground state of an explicit parent Hamiltonian with a gapless single-particle tunnelling spectrum. By construction these coupled cluster states variationally recover low order perturbation theory for the Hubbard model. Their failure in the strong coupling regime near the Mott transition diagnoses a fundamental limitation of coupled cluster doubles. Intriguingly, our family of coupled cluster wave functions includes a gapless state with zero quasiparticle weight, with a momentum distribution that is completely smooth at the Fermi energy.
full_list.abstract_zh: 多体理论中最成功的两个思想，即指数耦合簇 ansatz 和 DMFT，迄今为止必须单独开发。我们通过证明超立方晶格的无限维限制允许对耦合簇波函数的静态期望值进行精确的封闭式评估，在它们之间建立了联系，前提是簇振幅允许低阶分解。因此，评估误差——传统耦合簇理论中的一个严重问题——可以摆脱耦合簇状态表达性的限制。对于这一族的耦合簇态，d→infty 中的空腔结构精确地将晶格位点的环境还原为高斯格拉斯曼核，并且发现单体期望值的不可约图是位点对角的（类似于 DMFT 自能）。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 多体理论中最成功的两个思想，即指数耦合簇 ansatz 和 DMFT，迄今为止必须单独开发。我们通过证明超立方晶格的无限维限制允许对耦合簇波函数的静态期望值进行精确的封闭式评估，在它们之间建立了联系，前提是簇振幅允许低阶分解。因此，评估误差——传统耦合簇理论中的一个严重问题——可以摆脱耦合簇状态表达性的限制。对于这一族的耦合簇态，d→infty 中的空腔结构精确地将晶格位点的环境还原为高斯格拉斯曼核，并且发现单体期望值的不可约图是位点对角的（类似于 DMFT 自能）。由此产生的“杂质问题”是有限数量的格拉斯曼变量上的积分，而不是动态量子杂质问题，因此静态可观测量完全从静态自洽条件导出：DMFT的波函数对应物。对于簇振幅限制为一阶双精度的最简单情况，我们获得封闭形式的动量分布。我们证明任何动量分布都可以通过一个状态来实现，该状态是具有无间隙的显式父哈密顿量的精确且唯一的基态通过构造这些耦合簇态，可以不同地恢复哈伯德模型的低阶微扰理论。它们在莫特跃迁附近的强耦合状态中的失败诊断出耦合簇双打的基本限制，有趣的是，我们的耦合簇波函数族包括准粒子权重为零的无间隙态，其动量分布在费米能量下完全平滑。

full_list.title_en: Spin conservation protects the altermagnetic spin-splitter current from critical scattering
full_list.title_zh: 自旋守恒保护交变磁自旋分离器电流免受临界散射
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.41419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Near a magnetic transition, critical fluctuations scatter electrons strongly, but the charge current survives, because long wavelength fluctuations barely turn the electron velocity. In an altermagnet the electric field also drives a spin current, the spin splitter effect, and a nearly forward scattering event that flips spin moves an electron to the other spin band at almost unchanged velocity. We show that the spin current shares the protection of the charge current only when the fluctuations conserve spin. Solving the Boltzmann equation with the full collision operator, including its change with the magnetic order, we find that forward flips equalize the two spin populations at equal energy at the quasiparticle rate, which in two dimensions grows linearly with the correlation length, whereas spin conserving fluctuations relax the spin current at a rate comparable to the charge relaxation rate. Fluctuations with the same resistivity can thus move the spin splitter ratio in opposite directions. Energy conservation protects the part of the spin current that follows the band shift of the occupied states, and the splitting blocks forward flips once the spin Fermi lines lie farther apart than the inverse correlation length. A disorder series at fixed reduced temperature measures the initial fall of the ratio with the magnetic resistivity independent of the order amplitude, and the growth of this slope toward the transition identifies spin flip critical fluctuations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在磁转变附近，临界波动会强烈散射电子，但充电电流仍然存在，因为长波长波动几乎不会改变电子速度。在交变磁体中，电场还驱动自旋电流、自旋分裂器效应以及翻转自旋的近前向散射事件，使电子以几乎不变的速度移动到另一个自旋带。我们证明，只有当波动守恒自旋时，自旋电流才共享充电电流的保护。用完整的碰撞算子求解玻尔兹曼方程，包括其随磁序的变化，我们发现前向翻转使两个自旋布居在准粒子率下以相等的能量均衡，其在二维中随相关长度线性增长，而自旋守恒涨落以与电荷弛豫率相当的速率松弛自旋电流。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在磁转变附近，临界波动会强烈散射电子，但充电电流仍然存在，因为长波长波动几乎不会改变电子速度。在交变磁体中，电场还驱动自旋电流、自旋分裂器效应以及翻转自旋的近前向散射事件，使电子以几乎不变的速度移动到另一个自旋带。我们证明，只有当波动守恒自旋时，自旋电流才共享充电电流的保护。用完整的碰撞算子求解玻尔兹曼方程，包括其随磁序的变化，我们发现前向翻转使两个自旋布居在准粒子率下以相等的能量均衡，其在二维中随相关长度线性增长，而自旋守恒涨落以与电荷弛豫率相当的速率松弛自旋电流。因此，具有相同电阻率的波动可以使自旋分离器比率沿相反方向移动。能量守恒保护了跟随占据态能带移动的自旋流部分，一旦自旋费米线的距离远大于逆相关长度，分裂块就会向前翻转。固定降低温度下的无序序列测量与有序幅度无关的磁阻率之比的初始下降，并且该斜率向转变的增长确定了自旋翻转临界波动。
full_list.summary: 在磁转变附近，临界波动会强烈散射电子，但充电电流仍然存在，因为长波长波动几乎不会改变电子速度。在交变磁体中，电场还驱动自旋电流、自旋分裂器效应以及翻转自旋的近前向散射事件，使电子以几乎不变的速度移动到另一个自旋带。我们证明，只有当波动守恒自旋时，自旋电流才共享充电电流的保护。用完整的碰撞算子求解玻尔兹曼方程，包括其随磁序的变化，我们发现前向翻转使两个自旋布居在准粒子率下以相等的能量均衡，其在二维中随相关长度线性增长，而自旋守恒涨落以与电荷弛豫率相当的速率松弛自旋电流。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《自旋守恒保护交变磁自旋分离器电流免受临界散射》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Spin-conserving and spin-flip magnetic scattering in the altermagnetic spin-splitter effect
full_list.title_zh: 交变自旋分裂效应中的自旋守恒和自旋翻转磁散射
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.41414v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Critical magnetic fluctuations scatter electrons strongly near an ordering transition, but they barely degrade the charge current, because they scatter mostly through small angles. In an altermagnet the electric field also drives a spin current, and a nearly forward spin flip moves an electron to the other spin band at almost unchanged velocity. We develop a Boltzmann theory of the spin splitter ratio that keeps the full collision operator of quasistatic magnetic fluctuations and its change with the magnetic order. Fluctuations of equal total strength give the same resistivity for every fraction of spin flips, yet they can move the spin splitter ratio in opposite directions. Spin conserving fluctuations relax the spin current at about the charge relaxation rate, whereas forward flips equalize the two spin populations at equal energy at the quasiparticle rate, which in two dimensions grows linearly with the correlation length. Energy conservation on the split bands protects the part of the spin current carried by the band shift of the occupied states at every scattering strength, and the splitting blocks forward flips once the spin Fermi lines lie farther apart than the inverse correlation length. When flips dominate, a quarter to a half of the lattice band ratio survives. The transport time approximation reproduces the initial growth of the resistivity but recovers only a quarter to a half of the initial fall of the ratio, and a disorder series at fixed reduced temperature measures this fall independent of the order amplitude.
full_list.abstract_zh: 临界磁涨落会在有序跃迁附近强烈散射电子，但它们几乎不会降低充电电流，因为它们主要通过小角度散射。在交变磁体中，电场还驱动自旋电流，并且近乎正向的自旋翻转将电子以几乎不变的速度移动到另一个自旋带。我们发展了自旋分裂比的玻尔兹曼理论，该理论保持了准静态磁涨落的完全碰撞算子及其随磁序的变化。总强度相等的波动对于自旋翻转的每个部分给出相同的电阻率，但它们可以沿相反方向移动自旋分离器比率。

full_list.title_en: Spontaneous Circular Dichroism and Memory Effect from Surface Defects in Altermagnetic MnTe
full_list.title_zh: 交变磁性 MnTe 表面缺陷的自发圆二色性和记忆效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.41797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism has emerged as a new class of magnetism with vanishing magnetization and macroscopic time reversal symmetry breaking. Hexagonal MnTe is a g-wave altermagnet with a 307 K Néel temperature, large spin splitting, and an anomalous Hall effect. However, the relationship between altermagnetism and the anomalous Hall effect in MnTe remains debated. Here, using optical magnetic circular dichroism, we observe hysteresis and a memory effect in a MnTe bulk crystal below 250 K. No hysteresis is seen after polishing the bulk crystal and in thin films. We conclude that the hysteresis in magnetic circular dichroism in the bulk crystal is from surface defects. The similar temperature dependence and a sign change between circular dichroism and the anomalous Hall effect indicate that the origin of the anomalous Hall effect in transport is likely not intrinsic.
full_list.abstract_zh: Altermagnetism已经成为一种具有消失磁化和宏观时间反转对称性断裂的新型磁性。六方MnTe是一种g波改变磁体，具有307 K Néel温度、大自旋分裂和异常霍尔效应。然而， MnTe中的替代磁性与异常霍尔效应之间的关系仍然存在争议。在这里，我们使用光磁圆二色性，在250 K以下的MnTe块状晶体中观察到滞后和记忆效应。在抛光块状晶体和薄膜后没有发现滞后。我们得出结论，本体晶体中磁圆二色性的滞后是由于表面缺陷造成的。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: Altermagnetism已经成为一种具有消失磁化和宏观时间反转对称性断裂的新型磁性。六方MnTe是一种g波改变磁体，具有307 K Néel温度、大自旋分裂和异常霍尔效应。然而， MnTe中的替代磁性与异常霍尔效应之间的关系仍然存在争议。在这里，我们使用光磁圆二色性，在250 K以下的MnTe块状晶体中观察到滞后和记忆效应。在抛光块状晶体和薄膜后没有发现滞后。我们得出结论，本体晶体中磁圆二色性的滞后是由于表面缺陷造成的。圆二色性和异常霍尔效应之间类似的温度依赖性和符号变化表明，运输中异常霍尔效应的起源可能不是内在的。

full_list.title_en: Temperature Evolution of Magnon-Polarons in the van der Waals Antiferromagnet FePS₃
full_list.title_zh: 范德华反铁磁体 FePS₃ 中磁振子极化子的温度演化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.40968v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnon polarons, hybrid excitations arising from magnon-phonon coupling, were investigated in the van der Waals antiferromagnet FePS3 using magneto-Raman scattering measurements at temperatures ranging from 4 K to the vicinity of the Néel temperature (T_N = 118 K). The lower Zeeman-split component of the magnon-like mode, tuned by the magnetic field toward the lower-energy phonon mode, exhibits an avoided crossing. The corresponding magnetic field decreases from approximately 13 T at 4 K to 5.6 T at 85 K, bringing the effect within reach of a standard laboratory magnet. A model of three coupled bosonic modes shows that the magnon-phonon coupling constant, approximately 2.7 cm⁻¹ at low temperatures, decreases significantly with increasing temperature, following a trend similar to the temperature-induced softening of the magnon mode. This decrease in magnon-phonon coupling is discussed in terms of a possible reduction in sublattice magnetization due to thermal fluctuations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 磁振子极化子是由磁振子-声子耦合产生的混合激发，在范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中使用磁拉曼散射测量在 4 K 到尼尔温度附近 (T_N = 118 K) 的温度范围内进行研究。类磁振模式的较低塞曼分裂分量通过磁场向低能量声子模式调谐，表现出避免交叉。相应的磁场从 4 K 时的约 13 T 减小到 85 K 时的 5.6 T，使效果达到标准实验室磁体的范围。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《范德华反铁磁体 FePS₃ 中磁振子极化子的温度演化》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Topological spin textures in an antiferromagnetic monolayer
full_list.title_zh: 反铁磁单层中的拓扑自旋纹理
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.24186v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological spin structures such as magnetic skyrmions are of fundamental interest and promising for various types of applications in spintronics. Skyrmions have been predicted to emerge also in antiferromagnetic materials where they exhibit superior transport properties. They were experimentally revealed in synthetic antiferromagnets, however, still remain elusive in intrinsic atomic antiferromagnets. Here, we demonstrate how topological spin structures can be stabilized in an antiferromagnetic monolayer. Using spin-polarized scanning tunneling microscopy, we observe an antiferromagnetic spin spiral in the Mn monolayer and a collinear antiferromagnetic state in the Mn double-layer on Ta(110). Near the boundary to the double-layer spin structures equivalent to half of an antiferromagnetic skyrmion form in the monolayer as revealed in combination with first-principles calculations and micromagnetic simulations. Our simulations show how the topological state in antiferromagnetic material systems can be controlled by the configuration within a lateral heterostructure, resulting in trivial non-coplanar states or antiferromagnetic skyrmions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 拓扑自旋结构（例如磁性斯格明子）在自旋电子学中的各种应用中具有重要意义和前景。据预测，斯格明子也会出现在反铁磁材料中，它们表现出优异的传输特性。它们在合成反铁磁体中通过实验得到揭示，然而，在本征原子反铁磁体中仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们演示了如何在反铁磁单层中稳定拓扑自旋结构。使用自旋偏振扫描隧道显微镜，我们观察到Ta(110)上Mn单层中的反铁磁自旋螺旋和Mn双层中的共线反铁磁状态。结合第一原理计算和微磁模拟揭示，双层自旋结构的边界附近相当于单层中反铁磁斯格明子形式的一半。

full_list.title_en: Triplon thermal Hall response in a honeycomb-lattice J₁-J₂ Heisenberg antiferromagnet with Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interactions
full_list.title_zh: 蜂窝晶格 J₁-J2 海森堡反铁磁体中的三联热霍尔响应与 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.40910v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate triplon topology and the thermal Hall transport in a columnar valence-bond solid of a spin-1/2 honeycomb-lattice J₁-J₂ Heisenberg antiferromagnet. Inequivalent triangular sublattices, modeled by J₂^A≠ J₂^B, remove inversion symmetry at nearest-neighbor bond centers and allow in-plane Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya (DM) interactions. We identify the two symmetry-allowed in-plane DM vector patterns and present detailed results for the pattern parallel to the bonds including an out-of-plane magnetic field. Within a harmonic bond-operator treatment, we determine the triplon bands, their Berry curvatures and Chern numbers, and the triplon thermal Hall conductivity. The DM interaction and magnetic field generate nonzero Berry curvatures, but the numerically integrated Chern number of every isolated triplon band vanishes. Nevertheless, the energy-dependent Bose weighting of positive and negative Berry-curvature regions produces a finite thermal Hall response at nonzero low temperatures. We delimit the dilute-triplon regime in which the harmonic transport calculation is expected to be reliable. These results show that a vanishing Chern number band does not directly constrain the triplon response of a valence-bond solid. We also comment on the effects on the columnar valence-bond solid phase of a DM interaction between next-nearest-neighbor spins characterized by an out-of-plane vector pattern.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了自旋 1/2 蜂窝晶格 J₁-J2 海森堡反铁磁体的柱状价键固体中的三重子拓扑和热霍尔输运。由 J2^A≠ J2^B 建模的不等三角形亚晶格消除了最近邻键中心处的反演对称性，并允许面内 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用。我们识别了两种允许对称的面内 DM 矢量图案，并给出了与包含面外磁场的键平行的图案的详细结果。在谐波键算符处理中，我们确定了三重子能带、它们的贝里曲率和陈数，以及三重子热霍尔电导率。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了自旋 1/2 蜂窝晶格 J₁-J2 海森堡反铁磁体的柱状价键固体中的三重子拓扑和热霍尔输运。由 J2^A≠ J2^B 建模的不等三角形亚晶格消除了最近邻键中心处的反演对称性，并允许面内 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用。我们识别了两种允许对称的面内 DM 矢量图案，并给出了与包含面外磁场的键平行的图案的详细结果。在谐波键算符处理中，我们确定了三重子能带、它们的贝里曲率和陈数，以及三重子热霍尔电导率。 DM 相互作用和磁场产生非零贝里曲率，但每个孤立三倍子带的数值积分陈数消失。然而，正和负贝里曲率区域的能量依赖玻色加权在非零低温下产生有限的热霍尔响应。我们界定了稀三倍子体系，在该体系中谐波传输计算预计是可靠的。这些结果表明，消失的陈数带并不直接限制价键固体的三重子响应。我们还评论了以面外矢量模式为特征的次最近邻自旋之间的 DM 相互作用对柱状价键固相的影响。

full_list.title_en: Emergent Skyrmion Hall Effect in d-wave Altermagnets at Finite Temperature
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Emergent Skyrmion Hall Effect in d-wave Altermagnets at Finite Temperature
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27107v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with unconventional symmetry-dependent responses, offering a promising platform for spintronic applications. Here, we show that a voltage-controlled magnetic-anisotropy gradient drives altermagnetic (ATM) skyrmions in a nearly rectilinear, Hall-free manner in the absence of thermal fluctuations, owing to their strongly compensated gyrotropic response. Thermal magnons qualitatively modify this behavior by increasing the longitudinal drag through magnon--skyrmion scattering and generating a transverse reaction force through handedness-dependent skew scattering. Owing to the anisotropic altermagnetic magnon band structure, the relative transport weights of the two magnon handednesses are interchanged between propagation along the x and y directions, resulting in transverse skyrmion drifts of opposite sign. By contrast, along the high-symmetry direction, the two magnon handednesses remain degenerate and their transverse contributions cancel, preserving Hall-free motion even at finite temperature. We thus uncover a thermally emergent anisotropic skyrmion Hall effect whose direction-dependent magnitude and sign originate from the intrinsic symmetry-dependent magnon spectrum, making it a generic finite-temperature dynamical feature of ATM skyrmions. Our results establish a low-power route toward electrically controlled and thermally tunable ATM skyrmion transport.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.41826v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study polarization-resolved high-harmonic generation in a laser-driven two-leg Su--Schrieffer--Heeger ladder with asymmetric dimerization under periodic boundary conditions. A field linearly polarized along the ladder can generate both longitudinal and transverse radiation, whose harmonic content is controlled by lattice symmetry and electronic filling. Using symmetry analysis of the time-dependent density matrix, we show that reflection symmetry enforces odd-order harmonics in the longitudinal response and, when the transverse response is nonzero, even-order harmonics in the transverse direction. At half filling, an additional anti-unitary symmetry relating the occupied and empty bands suppresses the transverse current completely. A unitary chiral symmetry in the clean ladder relates the same bands but fails to enforce this cancellation, showing that band swapping alone is insufficient: the suppression requires both a density-matrix constraint that persists during the driven evolution and the appropriate transformation of the transverse-current operator. Moving away from half filling lifts this cancellation and allows transverse emission, while the reflection selection rule remains whenever reflection symmetry is preserved. Numerical calculations at quarter and half filling, combined with onsite potentials that selectively break the relevant symmetries, confirm these two distinct mechanisms. Thus, reflection symmetry determines which harmonic orders occur, whereas the interplay of anti-unitary symmetry and filling controls whether the transverse HHG channel is present at all.

full_list.title_en: Observation of light-induced Haldane gap in graphene
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Observation of light-induced Haldane gap in graphene
full_list.abstract: Symmetry and topology, encoded in electronic wavefunctions, play a central role in the electronic properties and emergent phenomena of quantum materials. While these properties are conventionally determined by the equilibrium Hamiltonian, strong optical fields offer a fundamentally different route by reshaping the Hamiltonian on ultrafast timescales, turning symmetry and topology into dynamically controllable degrees of freedom. Graphene provides a paradigmatic platform for realizing this concept, where circularly polarized light has long been predicted to dynamically break time-reversal symmetry (TRS) and open a topologically nontrivial gap at the Dirac point. Despite extensive experimental efforts, direct observation of this Dirac gap—the defining spectroscopic signature of the dynamical TRS-breaking induced topological phase—has remained missing. Here we directly observe this light-induced Dirac gap in monolayer graphene. Time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals that the gap emerges simultaneously with the optical field and exclusively under circularly polarized driving, directly linking its opening to dynamical TRS breaking. Together with Floquet theory, we identify the gap with a light-induced Haldane mass and reveal the associated nontrivial Floquet Berry curvature and Chern topology. By demonstrating dynamical TRS breaking in a prototypical non-magnetic material, our results establish optical driving as a route to ultrafast engineering of symmetry and topology, opening opportunities for dynamically tunable quantum matter beyond equilibrium.

full_list.title_en: Delocalized relativistic effects: Unraveling cooperative and anticooperative mechanisms
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Delocalized relativistic effects: Unraveling cooperative and anticooperative mechanisms
full_list.abstract: The term “relativistic effects” originates from the history of quantum mechanics and refers to the discrepancies between values calculated by models that consider relativity and those that do not. We introduce a methodology that opens up the possibility of analyzing the mechanisms by which relativistic effects combine in molecular structures containing multiple heavy elements. Through an n -body decomposition of relativistic effects, the individual contributions of each heavy element are revealed, along with collective contributions that can be either cooperative or anticooperative. Illustrations are given of the effects of spin–orbit coupling on total energy, electron density, and the intricate mechanisms by which these effects are transferred through space to the molecular electrostatic potential or the strength of intermolecular interactions. Near a heavy atom, such properties can be significantly more affected by the spin–orbit coupling effects produced by other distant heavy atoms, not bonded to the atom of interest or to each other. For molecular properties, it is shown that the influence of collective components (two-body, three-body, etc.) account for about one-tenth of the total effect of spin–orbit coupling.

full_list.abstract: Author(s): Yue Jiang, Shizai Chu, Xiaoru Zhang, Qicheng Zhang, Vincent Kerler, Keji Lai, and A. T. Charlie Johnson Topological phononic systems could enable backscattering-resistant control of mechanical waves for filters and interconnects in wireless and quantum technologies, but they are limited to low frequencies. The authors realize a gigahertz quantum spin Hall effect in nanoelectromechanical phononic crystals. They resolve the opposite handedness of the counterpropagating pseudospin branches in real space, and demonstrate a helical edge channel traversing two 120° corners without measurable loss. full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《交变磁多铁隧道结中的界面设计巨型多态电阻切换》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Atomic-scale structure, composition, and reversion of GP-I zones in Al–Zn–Mg alloys
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Atomic-scale structure, composition, and reversion of GP-I zones in Al–Zn–Mg alloys
full_list.abstract: Author(s): Sergei Starikov, Yury Lysogorskiy, Minaam Qamar, Anton Bochkarev, Matous Mrovec, and Ralf Drautz This study investigates the atomic-scale structure and stability of Guinier-Preston I (GP-I) zones in Al-Zn-Mg alloys. Large-scale simulations combine molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo techniques using a newly developed atomic cluster expansion (ACE) interatomic potential. Annealing of supersaturated solid solutions leads to the formation of nearly spherical GP-I zones composed of ordered Mg-Zn building blocks, with Zn atoms frequently shifting toward interstitial positions. The resulting precipitates exhibit distinct core-shell chemistry: a Zn-rich core surrounded by an Mg-enriched interfacial region, yielding an overall Zn/Mg ratio of approximately 1.5. Simulated HAADF-STEM images reproduce key features observed experimentally. At elevated temperatures, GP-I zones preferentially dissolve rather than transform directly into more stable precipitates, while vacancies and divacancies can stabilize small solute clusters even at high temperatures. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 113602] Published Mon Nov 02, 2026

full_list.title_en: Andreev-Enhanced Conductance in a Bilayer Graphene Quantum Point Contact
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Andreev-Enhanced Conductance in a Bilayer Graphene Quantum Point Contact
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.41915v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum point contacts provide a platform for probing mode-dependent Andreev reflection. Here, we demonstrate Andreev-enhanced conductance in a gate-defined bilayer graphene quantum point contact coupled to a superconducting aluminum electrode. Electrostatic gating enables sequential mode occupation, verified by normal-state conductance quantization. In the superconducting state, the conductance is enhanced within the conductance plateaus, while the enhancement decreases between plateaus, consistent with the nonlinear transmission dependence of Andreev reflection. The enhancement yields effective transmission probabilities up to 0.9, and extends over a bias window of approximately 140 μV, which we associate with a proximity-induced superconducting gap, close to the gap of the aluminum film. For in-plane fields, the enhancement persists up to the critical field, and the bias window follows the spectral gap predicted by Abrikosov-Gor'kov theory. In contrast, perpendicular fields suppress the enhancement approximately linearly from zero field, deviating from homogeneous pair breaking and indicative of flux penetration.

full_list.title_en: Anomalies of TQFTs coupled to parameter spaces and constraints on ground-state degeneracies
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Anomalies of TQFTs coupled to parameter spaces and constraints on ground-state degeneracies
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.42007v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anomalies of global symmetries can arise in long-range entangled quantum many-body systems and provide useful constraints on their dynamics. In this paper, we study anomalies of d-dimensional topological quantum field theories (TQFTs) coupled to parameter spaces and their implications for ground-state degeneracies. Specifically, we formulate anomalies as obstructions to constructing parametrized families of TQFTs. We discuss how the classification of these anomalies depends on the choice of topology on the universal U(1) (d-1)-form symmetry. In this framework, we use the projective ground-state bundle obtained by compactifying the TQFT on a spatial manifold to derive a general constraint relating its ground-state degeneracy N to its torsion anomaly ω, expressed as Nint_WωinZ for bundles W of spatial manifolds over closed surfaces. We apply this constraint to ground-state degeneracies of (2+1)-dimensional TQFTs with framing and 1-form symmetry anomalies and to obstructions to symmetry-preserving TQFTs. We also discuss implications for bordism generators and propose a conjecture on anomaly detection by manifolds fibered over surfaces.

full_list.title_en: Baker--Akhiezer sections from Higgs bundles and Landau levels in hyperbolic band theory
full_list.title_zh: Baker--双曲带理论中希格斯丛和朗道能级的阿基泽截面
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.42134v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As observed by Kienzle and the second author, rank-two O(3)-twisted Higgs bundles on the projective line encode all hyperbolic crystals of genus two: the spectral curves are the unit cells, and the Hitchin fibers are the abelian Brillouin zones. In a uniform magnetic field of two flux quanta, the lowest Landau level is one-dimensional at every nonzero momentum, and, as found by Iengo and Li, its dimension jumps to two at the zero momentum. We identify the states of the lowest Landau level with the Baker--Akhiezer sections of the Higgs bundles, and their zeros, the vortices, with the Baker--Akhiezer divisors. A family of nonzero momenta limits to the zero momentum exactly when each of the two vortices approaches the image of the other under the spatial inversion, and the states of the jumped level are labeled by the directions of limiting. On the Higgs bundle side, the zero momentum is the point where the Hitchin fiber intersects the Hitchin section. Such a family of Higgs bundles limits to the Hitchin section, thereby crossing to a lower stratum of the BB stratification, an example of the phenomenon investigated in terms of Baker--Akhiezer divisors by the first author with Figiel and Teschner.
full_list.abstract_zh: 正如 Kienzle 和第二作者所观察到的，投影线上的二级 O(3) 扭曲希格斯丛编码了所有二属双曲晶体：光谱曲线是晶胞，希钦纤维是阿贝尔布里渊区。在两个通量量子的均匀磁场中，最低的朗道能级在每个非零动量处都是一维的，并且正如 Iengo 和 Li 所发现的，它的维度在零动量处跃升至二。我们用希格斯丛的贝克-阿希泽部分来识别最低朗道能级的状态，用贝克-阿希泽除数来识别它们的零点，即涡旋。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Beyond the Kubo formula: unification of adiabatic and isothermal response in quantum systems
full_list.title_zh: 超越久保公式：量子系统中绝热和等温响应的统一
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.40810v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The static limit of the Kubo susceptibility describes the adiabatic response of an isolated quantum system, in which energy-level occupations remain unchanged, and generally differs from the isothermal susceptibility, where these occupations readjust to thermal equilibrium. In this work, we introduce a single dynamical framework in which the adiabatic and isothermal responses arise naturally as two distinct limiting regimes. This can be done by considering explicitly an open system version of the Kubo approach in which the dissipation is governed by a typical thermalization rate of the system. By exchanging the order of the static limit and of the vanishing thermalization rate limit, the protocol yields either the adiabatic or isothermal response. This protocol has a solid physical motivation in terms of the thermalization dynamics and is valid for generic systems. We apply it to the case of the magnetic response of the electron gas and reproduce the expected results.
full_list.abstract_zh: 久保磁化率的静态极限描述了孤立量子系统的绝热响应，其中能级占据保持不变，并且通常不同于等温磁化率，其中这些占据重新调整到热平衡。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个单一的动力学框架，其中绝热和等温响应作为两个不同的限制机制自然出现。这可以通过明确考虑 Kubo 方法的开放系统版本来完成，其中耗散由系统的典型热化率控制。通过交换静态极限和消失热化速率极限的顺序，该协议产生绝热或等温响应。该协议在热化动力学方面具有坚实的物理动机，并且对于通用系统有效。

full_list.title_en: Characterization of Phase Transitions with the Annealed Importance Sampling Algorithm
full_list.title_zh: 使用退火重要性采样算法表征相变
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.41500v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We We explore the use of the Annealed Importance Sampling (AIS) algorithm as a numerical tool to study phase transitions and critical phenomena. By mapping physical systems such as Ising and spin-glass models directly onto Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs), and extending the analysis to both synthetic and trained architectures, we use a unified RBM framework to compare the performance of AIS against standard Monte Carlo methods in regimes characterized by strong fluctuations and complex energy landscapes. The unified RBM formulation allows for massively parallel sampling, offering a scalable and precise alternative to traditional Monte Carlo methods. Building on a simple, heuristic mean-field AIS initialization derived from the weights of the network, the proposed scheme enhances sampling efficiency and accuracy across all systems considered, proving its effectiveness as a tool to detect and characterize phase transitions in discrete spin and spin-like systems. Our results show that a properly initialized AIS reliably estimates thermodynamic observables, including the partition function and magnetization, while accurately detecting both paramagnetic-ferromagnetic and paramagnetic-spin-glass phase transitions across various system sizes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们探索使用退火重要性采样（AIS）算法作为研究相变和临界现象的数值工具。通过将伊辛和自旋玻璃模型等物理系统直接映射到受限玻尔兹曼机 (RBM) 上，并将分析扩展到合成和训练架构，我们使用统一的 RBM 框架来比较 AIS 与标准蒙特卡罗方法在以强烈波动和复杂能源景观为特征的情况下的性能。统一的 RBM 公式允许大规模并行采样，为传统蒙特卡罗方法提供可扩展且精确的替代方案。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们探索使用退火重要性采样（AIS）算法作为研究相变和临界现象的数值工具。通过将伊辛和自旋玻璃模型等物理系统直接映射到受限玻尔兹曼机 (RBM) 上，并将分析扩展到合成和训练架构，我们使用统一的 RBM 框架来比较 AIS 与标准蒙特卡罗方法在以强烈波动和复杂能源景观为特征的情况下的性能。统一的 RBM 公式允许大规模并行采样，为传统蒙特卡罗方法提供可扩展且精确的替代方案。基于从网络权重导出的简单、启发式平均场 AIS 初始化，所提出的方案提高了所有考虑的系统的采样效率和准确性，证明了其作为检测和表征离散自旋和类自旋系统中相变的工具的有效性。我们的结果表明，正确初始化的 AIS 可以可靠地估计热力学可观测量，包括配分函数和磁化强度，同时准确检测各种系统尺寸的顺磁-铁磁和顺磁-自旋玻璃相变。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：蒙特卡洛统计采样, 热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《使用退火重要性采样算法表征相变》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Charge Pumping Leptogenesis from the Symmetric Mass Generation Phase on a Four-Leg Ladder Lattice
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Charge Pumping Leptogenesis from the Symmetric Mass Generation Phase on a Four-Leg Ladder Lattice
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.42103v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantized charge pumping in quantum Hall systems is a bulk topological property, typically manifesting on gapless boundaries as spectral flow through chiral edge modes upon flux insertion. When the boundary is anomaly-free, it can be symmetrically gapped by symmetric mass generation (SMG) interactions. However, the effects on quantized charge pumping at an interacting gapped boundary are unclear. We address this using density-matrix renormalization group simulations of a four-leg ladder quasi-(2+1)d realization of the (1+1)d 3-4-5-0 lattice chiral fermion model with six-fermion interactions at one edge. We find gapless modes near the interacting edge for both weak and strong couplings, but the edge can be in a fully gapped SMG phase at intermediate coupling. We also identify spontaneous breaking of the model's Z₂ symmetry above a critical interaction strength. Across all three boundary phases, we find quantized charge pumping with the same pumped charge per flux quantum. The spatial distribution of the pumped charge varies between phases. Besides charge pumping, we study how a single injected fermion propagates under open boundary conditions. In the SMG phase, an interaction-induced flavor-mixing current develops at the endpoints of the gapped edge, which is absent in the weak- and strong-coupling limits. This current reveals a charge-redistribution mechanism unique to the SMG phase. Additionally, we propose an analogy between charge pumping in this model and a topological leptogenesis scenario in the (3+1)d Standard Model. The anomaly-free chiral U(1) symmetries of the 3-4-5-0 model play a role analogous to the baryon-minus-lepton symmetry of the Standard Model. In both settings, charge pumping can be associated with a continuous deformation along a classically defined but quantum-anomalous direction, while a discrete subgroup remains an exact quantum symmetry.

full_list.title_en: Co--dsorption of terrylene and tetrapentacontane on hexagonal boron nitride - towards a two-dimensional Shpolskii matrix
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Co--dsorption of terrylene and tetrapentacontane on hexagonal boron nitride - towards a two-dimensional Shpolskii matrix
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.40733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Organic molecular emitters are promising building blocks for quantum technologies, but their use at two-dimensional interfaces is limited by diffusion, aggregation, and photobleaching. We present work towards constructing an ultrathin two-dimensional Shpolskii-like host-guest matrix on hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) by co-depositing terrylene fluorophores with the long-chain tetrapentacontane in a solution-phase process. We demonstrate that this approach disperses terrylene in a roughly one-nanometer-thin alkane layer without detectable phase separation and allows tuning the emitter density from ensembles to isolated emitters showing characteristic blinking behavior consistent with single-molecule fluorescence. Time-lapse confocal microscopy, autocorrelation analysis, and fluorescence recovery after photobleaching show that suppressed diffusion and stable emitter positions can be achieved in several samples with a tetrapentacontane matrix. Encapsulation with hBN from the top side further improves photostability, with emitters demonstrating long lifetimes despite high photon doses. Successful co-adsorption of isolated emitters and alkane matrix is a milestone towards extending Shpolskii-type molecular isolation to hBN and provides a route towards stable, interface-integrated molecular qubits.

full_list.title_en: Creating functional nanostructures for vortex manipulation in superconducting Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈+x thin films via focused He ion beam irradiation
full_list.title_zh: 通过聚焦He离子束照射在超导Bi ₂ Sr ₂ CaCu ₂ O ”+ x薄膜中创建用于涡旋操纵的功能性纳米结构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.41827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊ₓ (Bi-2212) is a highly anisotropic high-temperature superconductor exhibiting unique vortex dynamics due to its layered structure. Precise nanoscale patterning of ultrathin Bi-2212 films remains challenging, limiting controlled studies of vortex pinning. Here, we employ 30 keV focused helium ion beam (He-FIB) irradiation to fabricate periodic arrays of columnar defects with 100 nm spacings in optimally-doped Bi-2212 thin films, thereby creating artificial vortex pinning centers. Magnetotransport measurements reveal pronounced vortex matching effects, evidenced by minima in magnetoresistance and peaks in critical current at commensurate magnetic fields. The angular dependence of magnetoresistance and critical current scale with an effective magnetic field, indicating strong confinement of pancake vortices along irradiation-induced tracks. These findings demonstrate the efficacy of He-FIB nanopatterning in modulating the superconducting properties in Bi-2212 thin films, providing a platform for fundamental studies of vortex matter and advancing prospects for device applications based on this highly anisotropic superconductor.
full_list.abstract_zh: Bi ₂ Sr ₂ CaCu ₂ O (Bi-2212)是一种高度各向异性的高温超导体，由于其分层结构而表现出独特的涡旋动力学。超薄Bi-2212薄膜的精确纳米级图案化仍然具有挑战性，限制了涡旋钉扎的对照研究。在这里，我们采用30 keV聚焦氦离子束（ He-FIB ）辐照，在最佳掺杂的Bi-2212薄膜中制造具有100 nm间距的柱状缺陷周期阵列，从而创建人工涡旋钉扎中心。磁力传输测量揭示了显着的涡旋匹配效应，磁阻最小值和相应磁场下临界电流的峰值就证明了这一点。

full_list.title_en: Dipolar Exciton Polarons in a van der Waals Homobilayer
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dipolar Exciton Polarons in a van der Waals Homobilayer
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.41730v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fermi polarons exemplify how many-body interactions give rise to emergent quasiparticles, providing a fundamental framework for understanding interacting quantum matter. In electron-doped two-dimensional semiconductors, exciton polarons offer optical access to Fermi-polaron physics and electrical tunability, yet achieving stronger and more controllable exciton-electron interactions remains a key challenge. Here, we realize dipolar exciton polarons in an electrically tunable van der Waals homobilayer, where interlayer excitons with spatially separated electrons and holes act as quantum impurities carrying permanent electric dipole moments. These dipolar polarons exhibit substantially enhanced exciton-electron interactions, with binding energies more than four times those of conventional intralayer exciton polarons. We further demonstrate that Fermi-sea layer polarization provides an additional degree of freedom for controlling many-body interactions. In particular, the presence of a Fermi sea induces hybridization between oppositely oriented dipolar polarons, whereas confining the Fermi sea to a single layer suppresses this hybridization and produces orientation-selective many-body dressing. Our findings establish an experimental platform for dipolar-polaron physics in which dipole orientation and Fermi-sea layer polarization jointly govern many-body interactions, opening a route towards electrically tunable interactions and dipolar-polaron-mediated attraction between itinerant electrons.

full_list.title_en: Efficient Simulation of Gate Leakage Currents in Ultra-scaled Transistors from First Principles
full_list.title_zh: 根据第一原理对超大规模晶体管中的栅极漏电流进行有效仿真
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.40929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To ensure high electrostatic integrity in ultra-scaled field-effect transistors (FETs), thin gate dielectric layers are typically needed, potentially giving rise to (strong) leakage currents. Being able to model this effect is therefore crucial. Here, we show how gate leakage currents can be computed at the ab initio level in WS₂-hBN FETs by extending the well-established quantum transmitting boundary method (QTBM). Two main challenges are tackled: (i) the calculation of the open boundary conditions (OBCs) for the gate contacts and (ii) the solution of the resulting sparse linear system of equations A x = b where the matrix A possesses an unstructured sparsity pattern. We demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the state of the art and can be readily applied to simulate transistors with gate lengths exceeding 25 nm.
full_list.abstract_zh: 为了确保超大规模场效应晶体管 (FET) 的高静电完整性，通常需要薄栅极介电层，这可能会产生（强）漏电流。因此，能够模拟这种效应至关重要。在这里，我们展示了如何通过扩展完善的量子传输边界方法 (QTBM) 从头开始计算 WS2-hBN FET 中的栅极漏电流。解决了两个主要挑战：(i) 栅极接触的开放边界条件 (OBC) 的计算，以及 (ii) 求解所得的稀疏线性方程组 A x = b，其中矩阵 A 具有非结构化稀疏模式。

full_list.title_en: Electron-electron interactions mediated by overdamped vibrations: Implications for chirality-induced spin selectivity
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Electron-electron interactions mediated by overdamped vibrations: Implications for chirality-induced spin selectivity
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.40990v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS), we investigate spin polarization during molecular electron transfer through a correlated bridge in the presence of a rapidly relaxing Peierls mode. By modulating both electronic hopping and spin--orbit coupling, the mode mediates two-body spin-spin interactions, including isotropic, anisotropic, and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya exchange. We derive these interactions using an exact Lang-Firsov transformation for a four-site chiral bridge. We then include fast vibrational relaxation in the joint electron--vibration master equation and derive the reduced electronic dynamics to second order in the vibronic coupling, retaining both coherent and dissipative contributions and the finite-time buildup of the vibrational response. We test our derivation by numerical simulations, finding spin polarization accumulated at the acceptor after unpolarized injection, with nonmonotonic dependence on damping and bridge filling. Within the postulated local-loss model, our results show that rapid vibrational relaxation does not preclude spin polarization through a correlated bridge and provide a framework for assessing vibration-mediated interactions and dissipative dynamics as ingredients of CISS in molecular electron transfer.

full_list.title_en: Exact Electron Dynamics in Linear and Chiral Cavities: Complete Field versus Single-Helicity Reduction
full_list.title_zh: 线性和手性腔中的精确电子动力学：完整场与单螺旋简化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.40986v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can a chiral cavity turn a free electron into a Landau-like orbiting particle? We answer with exact solutions of three quadratic electron--cavity models in the dipole limit, valid at arbitrary coupling. A single linearly polarized mode dresses the electron mass, which delays its flight, slows the spreading of a wavepacket and entangles the packet with the cavity. The complete transverse field, with both circular helicities, keeps two commuting, gapless translations at any coupling, mode number and helicity splitting, so the electron stays ballistic and no synthetic magnetic field appears. Keeping a single helicity gives two inequivalent models that are not related by a gauge transformation: reducing before the Power--Zienau--Woolley transformation gives ballistic motion, whereas reducing after it gives a Landau-like crossed-quadrature Hamiltonian. They differ by a real uniform field B=sλ²/(2ω_c) (ω_c the mode frequency, λ the coupling, s=±1 the helicity). In the complete theory the frequency ω₋ₛ of the partner helicity, measured against g²=λ²/(2ω_c), decides between them: the electron is ballistic for a stiff partner, and Landau-like only at the soft-partner point, through an exact canonical reorganization that holds for the active sector but not for observables such as the electron--photon entanglement. Projecting onto one helicity after the PZW transformation is therefore not by itself a mechanism for synthetic magnetism; the mode content of the cavity is.
full_list.abstract_zh: 手性空腔能否将自由电子转变为类朗道轨道粒子？我们用偶极极限下的三个二次电子腔模型的精确解来回答，在任意耦合下都有效。单一线性偏振模式修饰电子质量，从而延迟其飞行，减慢波包的传播并使波包与腔纠缠在一起。具有两个圆形螺旋性的完整横向场在任何耦合、模式数和螺旋性分裂下保持两个交换、无间隙平移，因此电子保持弹道并且不会出现合成磁场。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 手性空腔能否将自由电子转变为类朗道轨道粒子？我们用偶极极限下的三个二次电子腔模型的精确解来回答，在任意耦合下都有效。单一线性偏振模式修饰电子质量，从而延迟其飞行，减慢波包的传播并使波包与腔纠缠在一起。具有两个圆形螺旋性的完整横向场在任何耦合、模式数和螺旋性分裂下保持两个交换、无间隙平移，因此电子保持弹道并且不会出现合成磁场。保持单一螺旋度会给出两个与规范变换无关的不等价模型：在 Power-Zienau-Woolley 变换给出弹道运动之前减少，而在它给出类似朗道交叉正交哈密顿量之后减少。它们的区别在于实均匀场 B=sλ²/(2ω_c)（ω_c 模式频率，λ 耦合，s=±1 螺旋度）。在完整的理论中，根据 g²=λ²/(2ω_c) 测量的伙伴螺旋度的频率 ω₋ₛ 在它们之间做出决定：电子对于刚性伙伴是弹道的，而仅在软伙伴点上是朗道式的，通过精确的正则重组，该重组适用于活动扇区，但不适用于电子-光子纠缠等可观察量。因此，在 PZW 变换后投影到一个螺旋度本身并不是合成磁性的机制；空腔的模态含量为。

full_list.title_en: Frustration-Induced 1/6-Vortex-Paired Phase in a Kagome XY Model
full_list.title_zh: Kagome XY 模型中挫败引起的 1/6 涡旋配对相
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.41161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Geometric frustration can fractionalize vortices in two-dimensional XY systems, but a given frustrated model usually hosts only a single type of fractional vortex. Here we study a kagome XY model in which an antiferromagnetic coupling J₁ and a second-harmonic coupling K favor two competing frustrated ground-state manifolds. For K/J₁<1/9, the ground states map onto those of the kagome three-state Potts antiferromagnet and support 1/3 vortices; for K/J₁>1/9, they map onto those of the kagome Ising antiferromagnet and support 1/2 vortices. At K/J₁=1/9, the two manifolds become degenerate, and bends in the domain walls between them carry 1/6-vortex excitations. Tensor-network calculations show that a finite-temperature phase with quasi-long-range order only in e⁶ⁱθ emerges from this degenerate point, separating the 1/3- and 1/2-vortex-paired phases. This 1/6-vortex-paired phase has no counterpart in either parent manifold, showing that competing frustrated manifolds provide a route to new fractional-vortex-paired phases.
full_list.abstract_zh: 几何挫败可以对二维 XY 系统中的涡流进行分数化，但给定的挫败模型通常仅包含单一类型的分数涡旋。在这里，我们研究了一个 kagome XY 模型，其中反铁磁耦合 J₁ 和二次谐波耦合 K 有利于两个竞争的受抑基态流形。对于 K/J₁1/9，它们映射到 kagome Ising 反铁磁体并支持 1/2 涡流。当 K/J₁=1/9 时，两个流形变得简并，并且它们之间的畴壁中的弯曲携带 1/6 涡旋激发。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Kagome XY 模型中挫败引起的 1/6 涡旋配对相》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

research_direction_note: 本日文献与团队研究的交集主要集中在第一性原理标注与结构优化、团簇展开与构型统计、等变神经网络与对称性保持表示、密度泛函理论和电子结构计算，并落到晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系、磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合、声子、有限温度和输运性质、缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学。对现有工作最直接的价值是提供可复用的表示、采样或验证流程，而不是替代具体材料体系的物理判断。后续筛选应优先核对原文数据是否包含结构、能量、力、应力、极化、自旋或有限温度轨迹，再决定是否迁移到铁电、磁性、缺陷和外场驱动模拟。

core_items.title_en: PASS: Perturbation augmented space group structure sampling for transferable Fe-O machine learning interatomic potential
core_items.title_zh: PASS ：用于可转移Fe-O机器学习原子间势的扰动增强空间群结构采样
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2607.28000v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Iron (Fe) oxidation is a fundamental phenomenon that is scientifically vital and technologically significant. Despite substantial experimental efforts, accurate atomistic modelling of Fe oxidation remains elusive, which requires a reliable interatomic potential, whose development hinges on a representative first-principles training dataset. However, Fe-oxygen (O) system is known for its structural complexity, rendering the generation of high-quality first-principles dataset challenging. In this work, we propose the Perturbation Augmented Space group structure Sampling (PASS) method to generate extensive dataset for Fe-O system consisting of small-cell structures (no more than 10 atoms). Based on atomic cluster expansion (ACE) framework, we present a systematic approach to developing a transferable machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP). The accuracy and capability of the ACE potential are thoroughly validated across pure Fe and Fe-O systems through bulk, surface, and interface properties. The large-scale Fe oxidation simulations with the ACE potential capture key features of the oxidation process, including the formation of an FeO-like structure consistent with recent experimental observations. This work demonstrates that the PASS method yields an accurate and transferable MLIP that can capture the reactive complexity of oxide growth while remaining computationally practical for extended systems.
core_items.abstract_zh: 铁（ Fe ）氧化是一种具有科学重要性和技术意义的基本现象。尽管付出了大量的实验努力，但铁氧化的准确原子模型仍然难以捉摸，这需要可靠的原子间电位，其发展取决于具有代表性的第一原理训练数据集。然而， Fe-oxygen (O)系统以其结构复杂性而闻名，这使得生成高质量的第一原理数据集具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了扰动增强空间群结构采样（ PASS ）方法，为由小细胞结构（不超过10个原子）组成的Fe-O系统生成广泛的数据集。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 铁（ Fe ）氧化是一种具有科学重要性和技术意义的基本现象。尽管付出了大量的实验努力，但铁氧化的准确原子模型仍然难以捉摸，这需要可靠的原子间电位，其发展取决于具有代表性的第一原理训练数据集。然而， Fe-oxygen (O)系统以其结构复杂性而闻名，这使得生成高质量的第一原理数据集具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了扰动增强空间群结构采样（ PASS ）方法，为由小细胞结构（不超过10个原子）组成的Fe-O系统生成广泛的数据集。基于原子簇扩展（ ACE ）框架，我们提出了一种开发可转移机器学习原子间势（ MLIP ）的系统方法。ACE电位的准确性和能力通过散装、表面和界面特性在纯Fe和Fe-O系统中得到彻底验证。具有ACE电位的大规模Fe氧化模拟捕获了氧化过程的关键特征，包括与最近的实验观察一致的FeO样结构的形成。这项工作表明， PASS方法产生了准确且可转移的MLIP ，可以捕获氧化物生长的反应复杂性，同时在扩展系统中保持计算实用性。

core_items.title_en: A Hybrid Message-Passing and Electric-Field Representation for Electrostatic QM/MM Embedding with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
core_items.title_zh: 一种具有机器学习原子间电位的静电QM/MM嵌入的混合消息传递和电场表示
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.41523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Within a hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics approach a small region of a large atomistic system is described quantum mechanically, while the rest of the system is represented by a classical force field. Despite this, the computational cost of the quantum calculation severely limits the accessible simulation and sampling time. Replacing the quantum calculation with a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) trained on quantum reference data can greatly increase the accessible simulation time. However, the accuracy and efficiency strongly depend on the specific way in which the MLIP incorporates information about the classical (electrostatic) environment. Here, we demonstrate that existing strategies based purely on features derived from an external electric field fail to distinguish certain environments, ultimately limiting their accuracy. As a solution, we propose an extension to the equivariant TensorNet architecture that mitigates this shortcoming by incorporating classical atoms close to the quantum region into the message-passing scheme, combined with features derived from the electric field for describing the environment farther away. We show that this combination achieves higher accuracy than either approach alone.
core_items.abstract_zh: 在混合量子力学/分子力学方法中，大原子系统的一个小区域被量子力学描述，而系统的其余部分由经典力场表示。尽管如此，量子计算的计算成本严重限制了可访问的模拟和采样时间。用在量子参考数据上训练的机器学习原子间势（ MLIP ）取代量子计算可以大大增加可访问的模拟时间。然而，准确性和效率在很大程度上取决于MLIP整合有关经典（静电）环境信息的具体方式。在这里，我们证明了纯粹基于外部电场特征的现有策略无法区分某些环境，最终限制了它们的准确性。

core_items.title_en: Electronic-Structure-Informed Many-Body Encoding for Quantum Machine Learning
core_items.title_zh: 用于量子机器学习的电子结构知情多体编码
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.40840v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Data encoding is a central challenge in quantum machine learning (QML), as it determines how classical information is mapped onto quantum states and influences the expressive power and efficiency of parameterized quantum circuits. Here, we introduce a physics-informed quantum encoding strategy that exploits the intrinsic many-body structure of electronic systems to establish a direct correspondence between the body order of input descriptors and the locality of quantum gates. Specifically, n-body electronic descriptors obtained from a single mean-field electronic-structure calculation are encoded through n-qubit gates, yielding a systematic hierarchy of quantum circuits with increasing many-body expressivity. Using reduced-density-matrix descriptors, we construct quantum machine-learning models incorporating one- through four-body encodings and benchmark their performance in predicting electron-correlation energies along bond-stretching potential energy surfaces. We demonstrate that increasing the body order of the encoding systematically improves prediction accuracy toward the full configuration interaction limit. Remarkably, disconnected many-particle densities constructed from lower-order electronic information achieve accuracy comparable to explicitly correlated two-particle densities in key cases, providing a computationally inexpensive route to higher-body quantum encodings. These findings establish a connection between the many-body structure of classical data and the design of quantum feature maps, offering a systematic, physically interpretable framework for enhancing the expressivity and predictive performance of quantum machine-learning circuits.
core_items.abstract_zh: 数据编码是量子机器学习（ QML ）的核心挑战，因为它决定了经典信息如何映射到量子态，并影响参数化量子电路的表达能力和效率。在这里，我们引入了一种基于物理学的量子编码策略，该策略利用电子系统固有的多体结构来建立输入描述符的体序与量子门的局部性之间的直接对应关系。具体地说，从单个均值场电子结构计算中获得的n体电子描述符通过n量子比特门进行编码，从而产生具有增加的多体表达率的量子电路的系统层次结构。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 数据编码是量子机器学习（ QML ）的核心挑战，因为它决定了经典信息如何映射到量子态，并影响参数化量子电路的表达能力和效率。在这里，我们引入了一种基于物理学的量子编码策略，该策略利用电子系统固有的多体结构来建立输入描述符的体序与量子门的局部性之间的直接对应关系。具体地说，从单个均值场电子结构计算中获得的n体电子描述符通过n量子比特门进行编码，从而产生具有增加的多体表达率的量子电路的系统层次结构。使用降低密度的矩阵描述符，我们构建了包含一到四体编码的量子机器学习模型，并对其沿着键拉伸势能表面预测电子相关能量的性能进行基准测试。我们证明，增加编码的身体顺序可以系统地提高预测精度，达到完整的配置交互极限。值得注意的是，由低阶电子信息构建的断开连接的多粒子密度在关键情况下达到了与显式相关的两粒子密度相当的准确度，为高体量子编码提供了一种计算成本低廉的途径。这些发现建立了经典数据的多体结构与量子特征图设计之间的联系，为增强量子机器学习电路的表达性和预测性能提供了一个系统的、物理上可解释的框架。

core_items.implication: 对《用于量子机器学习的电子结构知情多体编码》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Berry curvature quadrupole induced third-order anomalous Hall effect in altermagnetic KV₂Se₂O
core_items.title_zh: 贝里曲率四极杆在交变磁 KV2Se2O 中诱导三阶反常霍尔效应
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.41274v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, providing a symmetry-rich platform for exploring nonlinear quantum-geometric transport. In the d-wave altermagnet considered here, the antiunitary symmetry operation TC₄z enforces a vanishing momentum-integrated Berry curvature, while inversion symmetry forbids a finite Berry-curvature dipole. Consequently, the Berry curvature quadrupole (BCQ) can provide a contribution to the nonlinear Hall response, scaling as τ², where τ denotes the relaxation time. We derive a gauge-covariant Wannier interpolation formula that enables efficient evaluation of the BCQ directly from first-principles Wannier tight-binding Hamiltonians. Applying this framework to KV₂Se₂O, we calculate the momentum-space distribution of the BCQ and the associated chemical potential dependent nonlinear conductivity. The momentum-resolved analysis reveals that the dominant contribution originates from spin-orbit coupling induced avoided arossings, directly linking the gap structure to the sign-changing nonlinear response. Our work establishes a general first-principles route to higher-order quantum-geometric responses in altermagnets, opening avenues for exploring nonlinear Hall effects in next-generation spintronic and magnetoelectronic devices.
core_items.abstract_zh: 交变磁体将补偿磁序与动量相关的自旋分裂相结合，为探索非线性量子几何输运提供了一个富含对称性的平台。在这里考虑的 d 波交变磁体中，反酉对称运算 TC₄z 强制执行动量积分贝里曲率消失，而反演对称则禁止有限贝里曲率偶极子。因此，贝里曲率四极杆 (BCQ) 可以对非线性霍尔响应做出贡献，缩放为 τ²，其中 τ 表示弛豫时间。我们推导出规范协变 Wannier 插值公式，该公式能够直接从第一原理 Wannier 紧束缚哈密顿量有效评估 BCQ。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 交变磁体将补偿磁序与动量相关的自旋分裂相结合，为探索非线性量子几何输运提供了一个富含对称性的平台。在这里考虑的 d 波交变磁体中，反酉对称运算 TC₄z 强制执行动量积分贝里曲率消失，而反演对称则禁止有限贝里曲率偶极子。因此，贝里曲率四极杆 (BCQ) 可以对非线性霍尔响应做出贡献，缩放为 τ²，其中 τ 表示弛豫时间。我们推导出规范协变 Wannier 插值公式，该公式能够直接从第一原理 Wannier 紧束缚哈密顿量有效评估 BCQ。将此框架应用于 KV2Se2O，我们计算了 BCQ 的动量空间分布以及相关的化学势相关的非线性电导率。动量解析分析表明，主要贡献源于自旋轨道耦合引起的避免交叉，直接将带隙结构与符号变化的非线性响应联系起来。我们的工作建立了交流磁体中高阶量子几何响应的通用第一原理路线，为探索下一代自旋电子和磁电子器件中的非线性霍尔效应开辟了途径。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化, 有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量, Wannier 插值和有效电子模型，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《贝里曲率四极杆在交变磁 KV2Se2O 中诱导三阶反常霍尔效应》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Quantum Monte-Carlo study of spin-valley ferromagnetism in rhombohedral graphene
core_items.title_zh: 菱形石墨烯自旋谷铁磁性的量子蒙特卡罗研究
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.40864v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent capacitance measurements in bilayer and trilayer rhombohedral graphene reported large magnetic entropy above the Curie temperature, suggesting the formation of fluctuating local moments. Further experimental support comes from scanning tunneling microscopy experiments in rhombohedral hexalayer graphene, which directly visualized honeycomb electron-crystal order that strengthens upon heating before melting, related to the Pomeranchuk effect. Motivated by these experiments, we construct spin-valley local-moment Hamiltonians for the quarter-metal and half-metal phases. We extract their couplings from constrained Hartree-Fock calculations, and solve their finite-temperature thermodynamics with stochastic-series-expansion quantum Monte Carlo. For the quarter metal we find a continuous 2D-Ising transition at T_c approx 0.7 K, an order of magnitude smaller than the Hartree-Fock estimate (~30 K) and closer to the experimental scale of a few kelvin. For the half metal, we study the field-induced magnetization as a function of temperature with and without proximity-enhanced spin-orbit coupling. When spin-orbit coupling is negligible, intervalley Hund's coupling enhances the magnetic response. Strong spin-orbit coupling, as can be induced by a neighboring transition-metal dichalcogenide, gives rise to the standard spin-canted ground state at zero temperature. Upon heating, the in-plane polarization decreases more rapidly than the out-of-plane polarization. Surprisingly, despite the itinerant nature of the electrons, local-moment models with microscopically determined couplings appear to capture key finite-temperature magnetic properties of rhombohedral graphene without any fitting.
core_items.abstract_zh: 最近双层和三层菱面体石墨烯的电容测量报告了高于居里温度的大磁熵，表明波动局部矩的形成。进一步的实验支持来自菱面体六层石墨烯的扫描隧道显微镜实验，该实验直接可视化了蜂窝状电子晶体顺序，该顺序在熔化前加热时增强，与波美兰丘克效应相关。受这些实验的启发，我们构建了四分之一金属和半金属相的自旋谷局部矩哈密顿量。我们从约束 Hartree-Fock 计算中提取它们的耦合，并使用随机级数展开量子蒙特卡罗求解它们的有限温度热力学。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 最近双层和三层菱面体石墨烯的电容测量报告了高于居里温度的大磁熵，表明波动局部矩的形成。进一步的实验支持来自菱面体六层石墨烯的扫描隧道显微镜实验，该实验直接可视化了蜂窝状电子晶体顺序，该顺序在熔化前加热时增强，与波美兰丘克效应相关。受这些实验的启发，我们构建了四分之一金属和半金属相的自旋谷局部矩哈密顿量。我们从约束 Hartree-Fock 计算中提取它们的耦合，并使用随机级数展开量子蒙特卡罗求解它们的有限温度热力学。对于四分之一金属，我们发现 T_c 处有一个连续的 2D-Ising 转变，约为 0.7 K，这个数量级比 Hartree-Fock 估计值 (~30 K) 小，并且更接近几个开尔文的实验尺度。对于半金属，我们研究了在有或没有邻近增强自旋轨道耦合的情况下场感应磁化强度与温度的函数关系。当自旋轨道耦合可以忽略不计时，间隔洪德耦合增强了磁响应。强自旋轨道耦合（可由邻近的过渡金属二硫族化物引起）在零温度下产生标准自旋倾斜基态。加热后，面内偏振比面外偏振下降得更快。令人惊讶的是，尽管电子具有巡回性质，但具有微观确定耦合的局部矩模型似乎无需任何拟合即可捕获菱面体石墨烯的关键有限温度磁特性。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量, 蒙特卡洛统计采样, 热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《菱形石墨烯自旋谷铁磁性的量子蒙特卡罗研究》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: SKFitter: Symmetry resolved Slater Koster tight-binding models from first principles for s, p, d and f electrons, spin orbit coupling and magnetism
core_items.title_zh: SKFitter：根据 s、p、d 和 f 电子、自旋轨道耦合和磁性的第一原理，对称性解析了 Slater Koster 紧束缚模型
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.40729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Constructing accurate and physically interpretable tight binding (TB) Hamiltonians from first principles calculations remains challenging, particularly for materials exhibiting complex orbital hybridization, spin orbit coupling (SOC), and magnetic order. SKFitter is an open-source Python framework for constructing and optimizing symmetry resolved Slater Koster TB models directly from density functional theory (DFT) calculations performed using Quantum ESPRESSO or VASP. The framework supports s to f orbitals, incorporates on site SOC and site resolved magnetic exchange interactions, and accommodates both orthogonal and nonorthogonal basis. A central feature is the symmetry resolved parameterization of orbital manifolds, which allows independent two centre hopping integrals between symmetry allowed orbital groups and across distinct neighbour shells. SKFitter also identifies missing orbital contributions and guide systematic basis set refinement and optimizes parameters through weights. The resulting Hamiltonian can be used to evaluate anomalous (AHC) and spin Hall conductivities (SHC), and topological invariants. We demonstrate the framework using eight representative materials spanning semimetals, semiconductors, transition metals, f-electron compounds, and magnetic systems. Symmetry resolved models achieve band energy errors of 9 to 41 meV within 1 eV of the Fermi level. The fitted Hamiltonians reproduce characteristic features of the SHC response of Pt, the SOC dependence of the AHC of Fe, and the momentum dependent altermagnetic spin splitting of MnTe without any altermagnet specific interaction. For EuMn2Bi2, projection guided orbital refinement reduces the near Fermi level fitting error from 120 to 32 meV. Together, these results establish SKFitter as a flexible and reproducible framework for developing symmetry consistent, physically interpretable TB models of complex materials.
core_items.abstract_zh: 从第一原理计算构建准确且物理上可解释的紧束缚（TB）哈密顿量仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于表现出复杂轨道杂化、自旋轨道耦合（SOC）和磁序的材料。 SKFitter 是一个开源 Python 框架，用于直接根据使用 Quantum ESPRESSO 或 VASP 执行的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算构建和优化对称解析的 Slater Koster TB 模型。该框架支持 s 到 f 轨道，结合了现场 SOC 和现场解决的磁交换相互作用，并适应正交和非正交基础。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 从第一原理计算构建准确且物理上可解释的紧束缚（TB）哈密顿量仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于表现出复杂轨道杂化、自旋轨道耦合（SOC）和磁序的材料。 SKFitter 是一个开源 Python 框架，用于直接根据使用 Quantum ESPRESSO 或 VASP 执行的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算构建和优化对称解析的 Slater Koster TB 模型。该框架支持 s 到 f 轨道，结合了现场 SOC 和现场解决的磁交换相互作用，并适应正交和非正交基础。一个中心特征是轨道流形的对称解析参数化，它允许在对称允许的轨道组之间以及不同的相邻壳层之间进行独立的两个中心跳跃积分。 SKFitter 还可以识别缺失的轨道贡献并指导系统基组细化并通过权重优化参数。由此产生的哈密顿量可用于评估反常 (AHC) 和自旋霍尔电导率 (SHC) 以及拓扑不变量。我们使用半金属、半导体、过渡金属、f 电子化合物和磁性系统的八种代表性材料演示了该框架。对称解析模型在费米能级 1 eV 范围内实现了 9 至 41 meV 的带能误差。拟合的哈密顿量再现了 Pt 的 SHC 响应、Fe 的 AHC 的 SOC 依赖性以及 MnTe 的动量依赖性交变磁自旋分裂的特征，而没有任何交变磁体特定相互作用。对于 EuMn2Bi2，投影引导轨道细化将近费米能级拟合误差从 120 meV 降低至 32 meV。总之，这些结果将 SKFitter 确立为一个灵活且可重复的框架，用于开发复杂材料的对称一致、物理可解释的 TB 模型。

core_items.title_en: Proof-Carrying Materials: Falsifiable Safety Certificates for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
core_items.title_zh: 携带证明材料：机器学习的原子间电位的可伪造安全证书
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2603.12183v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are deployed for high-throughput materials screening without formal reliability guarantees. We show that a single MLIP used as a stability filter misses 93% of density functional theory (DFT)-stable materials (recall 0.07) on a 25,000-material benchmark. Proof-Carrying Materials (PCM) closes this gap through three stages: adversarial falsification across compositional space, bootstrap envelope refinement with 95% confidence intervals, and Lean 4 formal certification. Auditing CHGNet, TensorNet and MACE reveals architecture-specific blind spots with near-zero pairwise error correlations (r <= 0.13; n = 5,000), confirmed by independent Quantum ESPRESSO validation (20/20 converged; median DFT/CHGNet force ratio 12x). A risk model trained on PCM-discovered features predicts failures on unseen materials (AUC-ROC = 0.938 +/- 0.004) and transfers across architectures (cross-MLIP AUC-ROC ~ 0.70; feature importance r = 0.877). In a thermoelectric screening case study, PCM-audited protocols discover 62 additional stable materials missed by single-MLIP screening - a 25% improvement in discovery yield.
core_items.abstract_zh: 机器学习的原子间势（ MLIP ）用于高通量材料筛选，没有正式的可靠性保证。我们表明，在25,000材料基准上，用作稳定性滤波器的单个MLIP错过了密度泛函理论（ DFT ）稳定材料的93 ％ （召回0.07 ）。证明材料（ PCM ）通过三个阶段弥补了这一差距：组成空间的对抗性伪造，具有95 ％置信区间的自举信封细化，以及精益4正式认证。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习的原子间势（ MLIP ）用于高通量材料筛选，没有正式的可靠性保证。我们表明，在25,000材料基准上，用作稳定性滤波器的单个MLIP错过了密度泛函理论（ DFT ）稳定材料的93 ％ （召回0.07 ）。证明材料（ PCM ）通过三个阶段弥补了这一差距：组成空间的对抗性伪造，具有95 ％置信区间的自举信封细化，以及精益4正式认证。审核CHGNet ， TensorNet和MACE揭示了具有接近零成对误差相关性的架构特定盲点（ r < = 0.13; n = 5,000 ） ，通过独立的量子浓缩咖啡验证（ 20/20收敛;中值DFT/CHGNet力比12x ）证实。在PCM发现的特征上训练的风险模型预测未知材料的故障（ AUC-ROC = 0.938 +/- 0.004 ）和跨架构的转移（交叉MLIP AUC-ROC ~ 0.70 ；特征重要性r = 0.877 ）。在一项热电筛选案例研究中， PCM审核的方案发现了62种单次MLIP筛选遗漏的稳定材料-发现产率提高了25 ％。
